title: Define launch ICP and exclusions
user_outcome: Team qualifies comparable cafes
acceptance_criteria: Given a prospect record when reviewed then district site count service model POS and exclusion reason are recorded

title: Run merchant workflow interviews
user_outcome: Pickup pain and current workaround are evidenced
acceptance_criteria: Given 20 qualified cafes when interviews close then notes include peak volume interruption proxy current pickup method POS and willingness-to-pay response

title: Observe peak shifts
user_outcome: Pilot design reflects real counter work
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 observed peak shifts when coded then paid-to-ready handoff exceptions and staff interruptions use one shared rubric

title: Obtain one POS commercial contract pack
user_outcome: Team knows access rights and recurring costs
acceptance_criteria: Given candidate POS when gate review occurs then API licence approval path rate limits support fees and termination/export terms exist in writing

title: Secure sandbox and representative fixtures
user_outcome: Connector can be tested before merchant data
acceptance_criteria: Given approved developer access when sandbox is exercised then sale payment refund cancellation and reprint fixtures can be created or provider gaps are documented

title: Test dynamic receipt QR capability
user_outcome: Receipt scan opens correct private status
acceptance_criteria: Given 200 representative 58mm and 80mm prints when scanned across target phones then proposed first-scan success is at least 99% with no token truncation and reprints resolve same order

title: Validate non-native QR fallback
user_outcome: Tracking works without receipt-template changes
acceptance_criteria: Given provider cannot inject a unique receipt QR when pilot starts then counter QR plus pickup code opens only matching minimal order projection and failed attempts are rate-limited

title: Choose hosting region against constraints
user_outcome: Deployment choice has measured tradeoffs
acceptance_criteria: Given candidate regions when decision is signed then Gulf latency data residency service availability recovery cost and contractual SLA gaps are recorded

title: Confirm payments and privacy perimeter
user_outcome: Pilot avoids unlicensed fund handling
acceptance_criteria: Given proposed data and payment flows when counsel reviews then processor roles transfer mechanisms retention duties and prohibited custody or aggregation are written

title: Set paid validation offer
user_outcome: Pilot price tests willingness to pay
acceptance_criteria: Given interview evidence when offer is approved then fee duration success measures credit-on-conversion and excluded messaging costs are explicit

title: Gate 0 decision
user_outcome: Build starts only with feasible wedge
acceptance_criteria: Given gate evidence when reviewed then one POS path one QR path three candidate merchants legal constraints and stop reasons are recorded as go conditional-go or no-go

title: Create authenticated tenant location and role boundary
user_outcome: Only assigned cafe staff reach pilot data
acceptance_criteria: Given authenticated staff manager and observer users in two tenants when each reads or changes pilot orders then session expiry role and location scope are enforced cross-tenant access returns non-enumerating denial and denied attempts are audited

title: Enforce tenant-scoped relational integrity
user_outcome: Mis-scoped records cannot be persisted
acceptance_criteria: Given tenant-owned schemas when invalid cross-tenant location or order references are written then RLS plus composite foreign keys reject them

title: Create manual order intake
user_outcome: Pilot orders enter board without POS integration
acceptance_criteria: Given authorized staff when order alias and pickup code are submitted then one tenant-scoped order appears with received timestamp and no payment assumption

title: Build staff state transitions
user_outcome: Team marks preparing ready and collected
acceptance_criteria: Given current version when staff advances a valid state then board and audit history show actor occurred-at recorded-at and new version; stale writes return conflict

title: Build capability-protected guest status page
user_outcome: Guest tracks one order without account
acceptance_criteria: Given a random opaque receipt capability when opened then only alias item readiness ready time and collected time render; signup is not required plaintext capability is not retained in storage expiry is enforced and invalid tokens reveal nothing

title: Add reconnect-safe live updates
user_outcome: Status recovers after network loss
acceptance_criteria: Given client disconnects for 90 seconds when it reconnects then it fetches current version before applying newer events and never displays a regressed state

title: Create customer display and manual call fallback
user_outcome: Pickup continues without customer phone
acceptance_criteria: Given notification or customer-device failure when order becomes ready then display shows alias and staff can record manual call without changing payment or consent state

title: Capture pilot timestamps and compliance
user_outcome: Pilot outcome can be measured
acceptance_criteria: Given each order when states change then paid or received ready and collected timestamps remain separate and report exposes missing-transition and staff-compliance rates

title: Test bilingual mobile and staff flows
user_outcome: Arabic and English users complete core flow
acceptance_criteria: Given core screens at 320px and 200% zoom in LTR and RTL when keyboard and screen-reader checks run then focus order labels contrast and touch targets meet agreed WCAG 2.2 AA checklist

title: Prove minimal pilot backup restore and retention
user_outcome: Live pilot data has a tested recovery and expiry baseline
acceptance_criteria: Given pilot database snapshot and approved minimal retention schedule when isolated restore and expiry dry-run complete then order counts and audit history reconcile retention exceptions are listed and recovery steps and actual elapsed time are recorded without an uptime promise

title: Run paid one-branch manual pilot
user_outcome: Merchant sees measured workflow result
acceptance_criteria: Given authenticated staff opaque guest capabilities an approved minimal retention schedule and a successful backup restore proof when signed paid pilot completes then baseline and pilot median and P90 ready-to-collected time interruptions compliance QR opens and exceptions are reported with sample sizes

title: Gate 1 merchant validation
user_outcome: POS build follows observed adoption
acceptance_criteria: Given 3 to 5 pilots when reviewed then proposed gate checks at least 80% staff compliance repeat usage and at least two merchants accepting tested price; misses trigger revise or stop

title: Implement signed webhook inbox
user_outcome: POS events are durably accepted once
acceptance_criteria: Given valid event when received then signature is verified and inbox commit precedes 2xx; duplicate same ID and hash returns 2xx and conflicting hash is quarantined

title: Normalize order and payment separately
user_outcome: Fulfillment never fabricates payment state
acceptance_criteria: Given sale payment and fulfillment facts arrive when projected then each axis keeps independent state timestamps source and provider version

title: Handle duplicate and out-of-order events
user_outcome: Late delivery cannot regress truth
acceptance_criteria: Given shuffled duplicate refund payment and order events when replayed then final projections match ordered replay and terminal facts do not regress

title: Add overlap reconciliation
user_outcome: Webhook gaps become visible and repairable
acceptance_criteria: Given simulated outage when reconciliation runs from high-water mark with overlap then missing events import once and UI shows freshness and degraded state until current

title: Harden receipt capability lifecycle
user_outcome: Pilot-safe access scales to POS orders
acceptance_criteria: Given an eligible POS order when existing capability service issues rotates revokes or rate-limits a token then only keyed hash persists reprints retain canonical mapping old tokens return non-enumerating 404 and abusive attempts do not expose order existence

title: Connect proven QR route to POS order
user_outcome: Scan reliably opens matching live order
acceptance_criteria: Given chosen Gate 0 print path when sale is completed or staff fallback used then scan maps to one canonical order and reprint does not create another capability

title: Harden staff authentication and scoped permissions
user_outcome: Pilot access controls cover POS and service roles
acceptance_criteria: Given existing pilot authentication plus staff manager analyst and integration-service roles when POS-backed commands and support access run then capability location session and service scopes are enforced and denied attempts are audited

title: Add idempotent command and outbox processing
user_outcome: Retries do not duplicate state or messages
acceptance_criteria: Given same idempotency key and request hash when retried then original result returns; different body conflicts and committed events publish at least once with deduplicated consumers

title: Create integration health and poison-event queue
user_outcome: Failures are detectable and bounded
acceptance_criteria: Given invalid or repeatedly failing payload when retry budget exhausts then it enters review queue with tenant-safe diagnostics age and replay action

title: Decouple subscription outage from orders
user_outcome: Ready orders continue during billing failure
acceptance_criteria: Given billing provider is unavailable or tenant enters grace period when staff updates an existing order then ready and collected transitions still succeed and billing warning is recorded separately

title: Run paid pickup MVP acceptance
user_outcome: One connector is proven under peak conditions
acceptance_criteria: Given representative peak 30-minute webhook delay baseline tenant-security checks and restored pilot backup when acceptance runs then no duplicate orders occur current status recovers and fallback handles dependency loss without any provider SLA assumption

title: Define earn refund and redemption policy
user_outcome: Program economics and exceptions are explicit
acceptance_criteria: Given program proposal when approved then paid eligibility expiry refund reversal negative-balance and redemption rules are versioned with worked examples

title: Build append-only reward ledger
user_outcome: Balance is explainable and rebuildable
acceptance_criteria: Given earn redeem expire adjust reverse entries when projection rebuilds then balance matches ledger and original entries remain immutable

title: Enforce claim-once paid eligibility
user_outcome: One paid order earns once
acceptance_criteria: Given concurrent claims for same eligible paid order when submitted then exactly one ledger earn commits and others receive deterministic already-claimed response; unpaid or refunded orders earn none

title: Apply refund reversals idempotently
user_outcome: Refunds correct rewards without erasing history
acceptance_criteria: Given full or partial refund arrives before or after claim when processed twice then one policy-correct reversal links original earn and resulting balance follows documented negative policy

title: Make redemption atomic
user_outcome: Reward cannot be double-spent
acceptance_criteria: Given two concurrent redemption requests when balance permits only one then one succeeds and order benefit plus ledger debit commit together or neither commits

title: Create separate consent ledger
user_outcome: Channel and purpose choices stay independent before messaging
acceptance_criteria: Given customer choices when saved then operational WhatsApp promotional WhatsApp SMS and Wallet permissions have separate merchant purpose notice version source timestamp and opt-out state; QR access alone creates no consent

title: Meet merchant-owned Apple issuer precondition
user_outcome: Merchant controls issuer identity while platform acts as service provider
acceptance_criteria: Given Apple build starts when gate reviewed then merchant-owned active Developer Program membership Pass Type ID and certificate plus contracted service-provider authority custody migration and revocation terms are evidenced; a platform-owned co-branded program proceeds only after explicit counsel and Apple-contract clearance

title: Issue and update Apple loyalty pass
user_outcome: Customer carries current loyalty balance
acceptance_criteria: Given approved certificate when eligible customer adds pass then signed pass installs and balance update is fetched after APNs hint; unavailable notifications do not alter ledger truth

title: Publish Google Wallet loyalty pass
user_outcome: Customer carries current loyalty balance
acceptance_criteria: Given approved issuer and class when eligible customer saves pass then object installs barcode scans and balance updates; Demo Mode and notification cap never block core ledger

title: Monitor certificate and pass health
user_outcome: Expiry is caught before issuance stops
acceptance_criteria: Given certificate metadata when 60 30 and 14 days remain then alerts reach owners; rehearsed rollover issues and updates test passes without ledger changes

title: Run loyalty concurrency and device acceptance
user_outcome: Rewards and passes survive realistic races
acceptance_criteria: Given duplicate scans refunds concurrent redemption device restore and pass update throttling when tested then ledger invariants hold and both platforms show reconcilable balances

title: Onboard merchant-owned WhatsApp assets
user_outcome: Cafe controls recognizable sender and billing
acceptance_criteria: Given pickup MVP consent ledger and eligible merchant when Embedded Signup v4 completes then merchant-owned business phone payment method IDs token scope display name and approved utility template are recorded without waiting for Wallet loyalty

title: Budget with current WhatsApp rate card
user_outcome: Variable cost uses current rules
acceptance_criteria: Given beta pricing review when approved then rate-card effective date market category free-tier ownership taxes and per-merchant cost owner are stored; no unlimited claim appears

title: Send idempotent consent-bound utility updates
user_outcome: Opted-in customer receives relevant status
acceptance_criteria: Given valid operational consent and approved merchant template when ready occurs then one message intent is sent with merchant purpose and dedupe key; provider acceptance is recorded as accepted not delivered and absent consent is suppressed

title: Handle callbacks and ambiguous provider timeout safely
user_outcome: Delivery analytics distinguish evidence from uncertainty
acceptance_criteria: Given accepted send delivery callback failure callback or timeout without provider receipt when processed then states remain accepted delivered failed or unknown from exact provider evidence; unknown attempts enter review without blind resend and analytics never relabel acceptance as delivery

title: Decide UAE SMS channel support
user_outcome: Beta ships with an honest supported fallback set
acceptance_criteria: Given provider assessment when beta launches then sender registration status exact e& and du template tests segment costs and URL constraints are evidenced; unavailable or uneconomic SMS is documented and disabled while web display and manual-call fallback remain valid

title: Configure production PITR and recovery drill
user_outcome: Public production has a measured recovery path
acceptance_criteria: Given database loss scenario when restore drill runs then proposed public-release targets of RPO at most 5 minutes and RTO at most 60 minutes are met and monthly backup storage restore compute and egress costs are reported; a miss blocks this gate until remediation or a newly approved target and gate decision

title: Implement retention and deletion jobs
user_outcome: Expired personal data is removed predictably
acceptance_criteria: Given approved schedule when jobs run then receipt tokens raw webhooks contact data and logs expire or anonymize with counts while required ledger and audit records follow documented exception

title: Harden cafe devices and RTL operation
user_outcome: Shared devices remain usable through peak shift
acceptance_criteria: Given supported tablet and display matrix when eight-hour soak network loss RTL keyboard zoom and screen-reader checks run then session recovery no clipped critical controls and fallback path pass

title: Run tenant and abuse review
user_outcome: Pickup-only beta has bounded data risk before loyalty completes
acceptance_criteria: Given two-tenant fixtures and pickup abuse cases when reviewed then cross-tenant reads writes ID enumeration capability guessing and support grants are denied or audited; reward abuse cases join combined-release review after Gate 3

title: Create incident and degraded-mode playbooks
user_outcome: Cafe can continue and escalate
acceptance_criteria: Given POS messaging Wallet billing and database scenarios when tabletop runs then owner detection customer impact fallback communications and recovery verification are timed and recorded

title: Validate paid beta conversion
user_outcome: Pricing and support burden are evidenced
acceptance_criteria: Given paid beta cohort when review closes then accepted branch price churn intent support hours and gross-margin assumptions use actual cohort values and sample sizes; variable message cost is included only for enabled channels

title: Gate pickup-only public release
user_outcome: Pickup product can release without Wallet dependency
acceptance_criteria: Given pickup security consent production recovery device RTL accessibility fallback and paid-merchant evidence when release is reviewed then enabled messaging channels have passed consent delivery-state and cost checks disabled channels are documented and unresolved severity-one risks block release

title: Gate combined Wallet and operations release
user_outcome: Combined release joins independently completed workstreams
acceptance_criteria: Given Gates 3 and 4 ran in parallel when combined release is reviewed then pickup-only public gate and Wallet-loyalty acceptance have both passed and unresolved combined severity-one risks block release

title: Add organization and branch administration
user_outcome: One operator manages multiple locations safely
acceptance_criteria: Given multi-site tenant when admin assigns roles and configuration then branch scope defaults deny and consolidated view labels location and freshness

title: Add cross-location reporting controls
user_outcome: Group metrics remain comparable and scoped
acceptance_criteria: Given branches in different time zones or operating hours when report runs then metric definitions location filters currency and missing-data indicators are explicit and export respects authorization

title: Select second connector by paid demand
user_outcome: Connector investment follows pipeline evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given candidate POS systems when scored then contracted locations API coverage sandbox quality receipt path commercial terms and support burden determine recorded selection

title: Implement second POS adapter
user_outcome: Second paid segment uses same domain contract
acceptance_criteria: Given selected provider fixtures when sale payment refund cancel duplicate and out-of-order events run then normalized outcomes match first-connector contract and provider-specific gaps stay explicit

title: Prove second connector recovery
user_outcome: Outage recovery is repeatable
acceptance_criteria: Given webhook pause reordering and credential rotation when drill runs then reconciliation reaches current state once and degraded indicators clear only after verification

title: Run measured capacity test
user_outcome: Scale limits are known before sales commitment
acceptance_criteria: Given observed beta traffic shape when load increases to proposed two-times next-quarter forecast then P95 status read and transition targets error rate queue lag and database saturation are reported

title: Gate 5 expansion decision
user_outcome: Multi-site expansion has evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given production data when reviewed then second-connector paid demand branch controls recovery capacity and support economics produce go conditional-go or stop record

title: Evaluate optional preprinted QR journey
user_outcome: Lower-cost fallback has measured friction
acceptance_criteria: Given native print remains unavailable and scan demand exists when 100 journeys compare counter QR plus code against staff-created link then completion time abandonment and exposure incidents determine keep or reject

title: Evaluate managed Wallet provider
user_outcome: Buy-versus-build uses migration evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given pass operations exceed agreed support threshold when two-week spike runs then branding custody per-pass cost export incident support and reissue path are scored before any switch

title: Evaluate SMS as merchant add-on
user_outcome: Channel is offered only if deliverable and economic
acceptance_criteria: Given sender registration reopens and three merchants request SMS when 200 consented sends run then carrier delivery segment cost opt-out and support load decide availability

title: Evaluate partial-order readiness
user_outcome: Complex kitchens show useful batch progress
acceptance_criteria: Given at least three paid merchants report split fulfillment when shadow model tracks 200 orders then mismatch rate staff burden and customer comprehension determine build decision

title: Evaluate pickup-tail prediction
user_outcome: Intervention targets are tested without fake certainty
acceptance_criteria: Given at least 500 timestamp-complete orders when blinded baseline model scores tail risk then calibration false-alert rate and actionable lead time beat simple location baseline before UI exposure

title: Evaluate loyalty offer economics
user_outcome: Discount does not outrun margin
acceptance_criteria: Given three merchants provide item-margin bounds when randomized eligible cohorts run under approved terms then incremental repeat rate reward cost and confidence interval decide continuation

title: Evaluate geofence pass prompts
user_outcome: Location prompt remains optional and useful
acceptance_criteria: Given explicit location permission and supported Wallet accounts when capped pilot runs then opt-in prompt rate visits and complaints are measured; core journey works without it

title: Evaluate local printer bridge
user_outcome: Operational burden is known before deployment
acceptance_criteria: Given contracted demand and official vendor permission when one-store four-week appliance trial runs then duplicate prints offline recovery remote support minutes and certificate rotation decide reject or productize

title: Evaluate privacy-preserving benchmark report
user_outcome: Operator compares performance without peer leakage
acceptance_criteria: Given at least 20 consenting locations and disclosure review when benchmark is generated then cohorts meet minimum size and re-identification tests pass before merchant display

title: Evaluate Egypt market separately
user_outcome: Expansion decision avoids inflated UAE TAM
acceptance_criteria: Given UAE repeatability and local research budget when Egypt study runs then licence denominator POS mix payment route price sensitivity and 15 merchant interviews are reported independently

title: Select first country-sector-POS cell
user_outcome: Team funds one bounded proof rather than a GCC-wide launch
acceptance_criteria: Given country sector workflow and connector scorecards when Gate 0 meets then one first cell and one reserve cell are named with buyer pain paid-pilot route system-of-record boundary stop conditions and evidence gaps; selection is not obligated to UAE cafes

title: Define six-country evidence register
user_outcome: Unknown country facts stay visible
acceptance_criteria: Given Bahrain Kuwait Oman Qatar Saudi Arabia and UAE when register is reviewed then each has dated sources for target activity commercial access connector route and unknowns; incompatible enterprise and branch counts are not summed

title: Commission country regulatory decision cards
user_outcome: Launch claims follow country-specific review
acceptance_criteria: Given a proposed country cell when local counsel reviews then entity licensing privacy data transfer consumer messaging invoice payments employment and sector-specific blockers are recorded with authority citations and review date; absent review blocks launch

title: Secure paid transfer-pilot offer
user_outcome: Merchant willingness to pay is tested in selected cell
acceptance_criteria: Given selected cell when offer is signed then paid fee branch scope workflow baseline success measures integration exclusions support hours and renewal test are explicit; no free pilot or GCC-wide promise appears

title: Add merchant group legal entity brand branch hierarchy
user_outcome: Multi-country organization is represented without conflation
acceptance_criteria: Given one group with multiple legal entities brands and branches when administered then each branch resolves exactly one operating legal entity country currency timezone locale and provider configuration while group reporting preserves boundaries

title: Add country sector and module entitlements
user_outcome: Branches activate only contracted supported workflows
acceptance_criteria: Given plan and branch configuration when a user opens or calls a disabled module then UI and API deny it without hiding existing records; entitlement changes are audited and do not alter source facts

title: Implement ISO currency minor-unit handling
user_outcome: Amounts round and display correctly across GCC currencies
acceptance_criteria: Given AED SAR QAR BHD KWD and OMR fixtures when amounts import calculate export and render then configured ISO exponents are respected including three decimal minor units for BHD KWD and OMR with no float arithmetic or silent currency conversion

title: Add branch locale timezone and phone configuration
user_outcome: Country experiences format data correctly
acceptance_criteria: Given Arabic and English branches across six GCC countries when status timestamps phone inputs and notifications render then RTL remains usable IANA branch timezone drives local display and country-aware E.164 validation accepts valid fixtures without assuming one GCC format

title: Configure invoice PSP and sender ownership per country
user_outcome: Provider responsibilities are explicit per legal entity
acceptance_criteria: Given branch country and legal entity when invoice payment or message action starts then country-versioned configuration identifies system of record licensed PSP invoice issuer sender asset owner billing owner and disabled channels; no universal GCC account is assumed

title: Version message policies and country rate cards
user_outcome: Channel cost and permission use dated country evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given provider country category and effective date when message intent is priced then immutable rate-card version consent purpose sender owner and estimated unit cost are attached; missing or expired config suppresses paid send and preserves web fallback

title: Enforce regional data-scope and transfer gates
user_outcome: Country data moves only under approved scope
acceptance_criteria: Given branch country data class processor region and destination when storage support export or cross-group reporting is requested then a versioned country decision permits redacts localizes or blocks action and audit records legal basis; six-country release needs six reviewed cards

title: Generalize verified purchase-fact adapter
user_outcome: Loyalty consumes paid commerce or service facts without cafe assumptions
acceptance_criteria: Given connector emits a verified paid order or completed paid service when normalized then purchase fact records source type legal entity branch currency gross amount payment state completion evidence refunds and external identity; loyalty consumes this contract and never infers payment from workflow completion

title: Add bounded service-queue module
user_outcome: Non-order visits use truthful queue states
acceptance_criteria: Given entitled service branch when staff handles a visit then only queued called serving completed or left transitions are allowed with actor and timestamps; order fulfillment state remains separate and module can be disabled

title: Prove Salla or Zid retail handoff adapter
user_outcome: BOPIS handoff uses existing commerce identity
acceptance_criteria: Given selected Saudi merchant sandbox when paid or approved order cancellation refund ready and collection fixtures run then adapter preserves canonical order and store identity and exposes only verified provider states; absent pickup-ready API becomes staff-owned state and is not assumed

title: Add arrival and collection-proof option
user_outcome: Store distinguishes arrival from verified handoff
acceptance_criteria: Given entitled BOPIS branch when customer checks in and staff completes collection then arrival and collection evidence are timestamped separately with authorized correction and fallback; neither action changes payment or inventory truth

title: Prototype express car-wash job workflow
user_outcome: Customer tracks bounded service without workshop software
acceptance_criteria: Given five observed express sites confirm off-site waiting pain when optional pack is trialed then vehicle reference and queued called serving completed left states work with manual fallback; inspection parts invoicing bay optimization and repair work orders remain excluded

title: Integrate appointment arrival without booking engine
user_outcome: Existing appointments gain check-in and waiting visibility
acceptance_criteria: Given partner exposes appointment identity staff service time cancellation and consent when adapter runs then check-in and queue updates attach to source appointment; availability booking reschedule deposits commissions and calendars remain external

title: Separate contract entitlement from visit rewards
user_outcome: Membership validity and visit stamps cannot be confused
acceptance_criteria: Given membership connector facts and visit scans when processed then active frozen expired and renewal states remain source-owned while visit attendance and optional reward ledger stay separate; visits never renew contracts or infer payment

title: Block clinic enablement pending health review
user_outcome: Healthcare cannot activate as generic merchant queue
acceptance_criteria: Given clinic or healthcare classification when entitlement is requested then activation is blocked until separate country-specific health privacy patient-safety clinical-priority accessibility security incident and integration review is approved; no patient pilot data is collected beforehand

title: Run paid second country-sector transfer pilot
user_outcome: Kernel transfer is evidenced beyond first reference implementation
acceptance_criteria: Given selected second country and different sector when paid pilot completes then baseline staff compliance customer use exception rate support hours integration time and renewal price are reported against that branch only with provider and legal gaps visible

title: Reconcile sector exceptions and refunds
user_outcome: Purchase and handoff histories remain explainable
acceptance_criteria: Given cancellation partial refund no-show left queue and post-completion correction fixtures when replayed out of order then source purchase facts workflow history and loyalty reversal reconcile without cross-module state mutation

title: Decide second cell productionization
user_outcome: Expansion follows paid transferable evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given transfer pilot and exception report when gate meets then legal clearance merchant renewal intent support economics connector reliability localization and fallback produce go conditional-go or stop for that country-sector cell only

title: Create country launch checklist from approved cell
user_outcome: Each additional country repeats explicit gates
acceptance_criteria: Given a country-sector cell has passed when launch checklist is signed then legal card provider ownership rate cards data scope language support incident route paid merchant and rollback owner are current; checklist grants no other sector or country

title: Review module and country portfolio quarterly
user_outcome: Unsupported breadth is retired before it becomes platform debt
acceptance_criteria: Given live and discovery cells when quarterly review occurs then paid branches usage support margin legal changes connector health and renewal evidence decide invest hold or retire per module and country; no roadmap item implies all six countries or sectors ship
